title: Project Manager
description:
#### **EDPSoft : Corporate DNA**


**EDP Group** has embedded deep values of talent branding policy that appreciates infinite capabilities of humanware.


Opportunity to be involved in acompany that is bold and ambitious.


  
#### **EDPSoft Group is an equal opportunity employer.**


**Committed to Success**
------------------------


Our clients are looking to stay ahead in the world of investment management. By taking a consultative approach, we deliver cutting edge solutions that drive our customers.


**Take Ownership**
------------------


Following a checklist or doing busy work is not in our nature. Here at EDP Soft, we are committed to driving results and investing in growth.


**Inspire Our Teammates**
-------------------------


We encourage our employees to be the best in class. Through close collaboration and peer\-to\-peer discussion, our teams share knowledge and resources that inspires each member to develop and grow.


**Innovate Intelligently**
--------------------------


Only through consistent improvement, we will remain an industry leading provider of software and services. We encourage new ideas and embrace risk in order to keep our solutions ahead of the curve.
  
#### **Project Manager**

You will be a cross functional team player with active collab between client, sales team, dev team and will play client facing role including on\-board and project management thereafter.  

  

  



* Liaison between multi stakeholder environment
* Have adequate tech knowledge to hold deep conversations
* Consulting approach to solve business problems
* Manage overall P\&L responsibility
